regulatory_model.quote: It shall be unlawful and a misdemeanor for any person to engage in any of the following acts: To practice genetic counseling or to represent themselves to be a licensed genetic counselor as defined in this chapter without having at the time of so doing, a valid license issued under this chapter

credential_type.quote: "Licensed genetic counselor" means a person licensed under this chapter to engage in the practice of genetic counseling.

is_mandatory.quote: Effective July 1, 2023, a license shall be required to engage in the practice of genetic counseling.

title_protection.quote: No person who is not so licensed may use in connection with their name or place of business the title genetic counselor, licensed genetic counselor, gene counselor, genetic consultant, genetic associate, or any words, letters, abbreviations, or insignia indicating or implying that a person holds a genetic counselor license unless the person holds a genetic counselor license.

definition_quote.value: "Practice of genetic counseling" means a communication process, conducted by one or more appropriately trained individuals that may include: obtaining and evaluating individual, family, and medical histories to determine genetic risk; discussing features, natural history, means of diagnosis; identifying, ordering, and coordinating genetic laboratory tests; integrating genetic laboratory test results; explaining clinical implications; evaluating responses and providing counseling; identifying community resources; providing written documentation; and when necessary, referring patients to a physician for diagnosis and treatment.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of genetic counseling" means a communication process, conducted by one or more appropriately trained individuals that may include:

value: Obtaining and evaluating individual, family, and medical histories to determine genetic risk
Discussing features, natural history, means of diagnosis, genetic and environmental factors, and management of risk
Identifying, ordering, and coordinating genetic laboratory tests
Integrating genetic laboratory test results and other diagnostic studies with personal and family medical history
Explaining clinical implications of genetic laboratory tests and other diagnostic studies
Evaluating client or family responses and providing client-centered counseling and anticipatory guidance
Providing written documentation of medical, genetic, and counseling information
Referring patients to a physician for diagnosis and treatment when necessary
methods_authorized.quote: Obtaining and evaluating individual, family, and medical histories to determine genetic risk for genetic/medical conditions and diseases in a patient, the patient's offspring, and other family members

certifying_bodies_accepted.quote: Have passed the examination for certification as: A genetic counselor by the American Board of Genetic Counseling or the American Board of Medical Genetics, or successor or equivalent; or A medical geneticist by the American Board of Medical Genetics, or successor or equivalent.

temporary_license_duration_years.quote: The license shall be valid for one year from the date of its issue and may be renewed for an additional one year if an applicant fails the ABGC or ABMG certification exam.

temporary_license_supervisor_types.quote: A provisional licensed genetic counselor shall be under the general supervision of a licensed genetic counselor or a licensed physician at all times during which the provisional licensed genetic counselor performs clinical genetic counseling.

supervision_contract_required.quote: An application for extension shall be signed by a supervising licensed genetic counselor.

supervisor_physical_presence_required.quote: The department shall adopt rules governing such supervision and direction which may not require the immediate physical presence of the supervising licensed genetic counselor.

genetic_test_ordering_authority.quote: Identifying, ordering, and coordinating genetic laboratory tests as appropriate for the genetic assessment;

referral_to_physician_required_when_outs.quote: When necessary, referring patients to a physician for diagnosis and treatment.

federal_employee_exemption.quote: Any person employed as a genetic counselor by the federal government or an agency thereof if the person provides genetic counseling services solely under the direction and control of the organization by which such person is employed;
